security_summary: Senior secured; first-priority blanket lien on substantially all personal property of the borrower and guarantors (accounts, chattel paper, deposit accounts, equipment, fixtures, general intangibles, instruments, inventory, books/records, and proceeds), subject to customary exclusions/permitted liens. Guarantees from Asteron Care Holdings, Inc. and the five regional operating subsidiaries (Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, Northeast, Great Lakes, Central Operations, LLC). Reinstated exit debt and new-money term debt share the SAME first-priority lien class (pari passu). Source: executed Guaranty and Security Agreement (effective 2026-03-31) and Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (executed 2026-03-20, effective 2026-03-31) -- the CURRENT/Exit Facility. No inventory line exists on this borrower's Balance Sheet (healthcare-services business), so inventory is not tracked as a pledged component below even though the security agreement nominally covers it.
_pledged_components_note: 'Operating lease ROU assets' and 'Other current assets'/'Tax refund receivable' are excluded -- ROU assets are not owned property available to a secured creditor (they track leased real estate liabilities), and the other two are not identifiable collateral categories under the security agreement. Goodwill ($78.1M at June 2026, ~39% of total assets) is nominal/intangible collateral only -- flagged in coverage cuts via 'Ex-goodwill assets'. No inventory line exists on the Balance Sheet (see security_summary).
